Services

What we fix

Tap a service to see what it covers. Pricing varies by vehicle, so call either shop and we will give you an honest, upfront quote.

Full synthetic, synthetic blend, and conventional oil changes. We use quality filters and check all fluid levels at every visit.
Pad replacements, rotor resurfacing or replacement, caliper service, and brake fluid flushes to keep you stopping safely.
State-of-the-art scan tools to read fault codes, diagnose check engine lights, and identify performance issues fast.
Mounting, balancing, rotation, and flat repair. We'll advise on tread wear and help you find the right tires for your budget.
Official Pennsylvania safety and emissions inspections performed by licensed technicians. Quick turnaround, no surprises.
Fluid changes, filter replacements, and diagnostics for both automatic and manual transmissions.
Refrigerant recharge, leak detection, compressor diagnosis, and full system inspections to keep you cool all summer.
Battery testing, replacement, and terminal cleaning. We also perform alternator and starter diagnostics.
Coolant flushes, power steering fluid, brake fluid, and differential service to protect your drivetrain.
Shocks, struts, control arms, tie rods, and alignments. We'll identify the rattle or pull and fix it right.
Don't see what you need? We handle it all. Call either shop, tell us what the car is doing, and we will point you straight.

About us

Two Harrisburg locals

On The Go Services was founded by Carlos Lozada and ThoMas Mari, two Harrisburg locals who saw firsthand how the auto industry takes advantage of customers who don't know what's under their hood.

Carlos is a self-taught mechanic who went from "the backyard guy" to a factory-trained technician. ThoMas learned from his grandfather and found his calling after an expensive lesson at 17. Together they built a shop where transparency isn't optional.

At On The Go, we walk you through the problem, show you the part, and give you options, not ultimatums. We opened our garage on N. Cameron Street because we believe this community deserves better.

In the news: The Burg wrote about the shop, and how it set out to give Harrisburg transparent, affordable auto repair.
"The reason we are doing this isn't about the money. I try to give everybody the same experience I would want."Carlos Lozada, co-founder
